dedupe_keys.name: hl7 fhir r5 location organization and healthcareservice resources standard for health facility and service data

description: HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) is the dominant standard for exchanging health information, and its Location, Organization and HealthcareService resources are the standard way health systems publish where facilities are and what services they provide. The specification is produced by HL7 International, with the Location resource maintained by the Patient Administration work group; R5 (v5.0.0) is the current published version, with R4 and R4B widely deployed. Coverage: an international standard used by national facility registries, insurers and hospital systems worldwide. A Location covers places from a single bed or room to a hospital building, mobile clinic, ambulance or jurisdiction, with status, operational status, type, address, geographic position, managing organisation, part-of hierarchy, hours of operation and a boundary; Organization and HealthcareService describe who operates a site and which services, specialties and eligibility it offers. Format and access: web specification with JSON, XML and RDF schemas and examples, served through RESTful FHIR APIs by implementers; free. Licence: the specification is CC0 (no rights reserved), while the HL7 and FHIR names are trademarks. Caveats: FHIR defines structure, not content, so facility data quality depends on each registry, and implementation guides constrain the resources differently by country. Simulation uses: a common schema for health facility inventories and bed or service capacity used in emergency response and capacity planning models of healthcare. Related records: Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) maps facilities worldwide, and EDXL-HAVE (data-oasis-edxl-have-hospital-availability-exchange) exchanges hospital bed availability during emergencies.
